name: bio.clips/clips-bio
title: clips.bio
description: YouTube Most Replayed moments, titles, hashtags, chapters, hook scoring, thumbnails, clip links.

tools.name: generate_youtube_titles
tools.description: Generate click-worthy YouTube or Shorts title ideas for a topic.

tools.name: generate_hashtags
tools.description: Suggest hashtags for a short video on YouTube Shorts, TikTok or Instagram Reels.

tools.name: generate_youtube_chapters
tools.description: Turn rough notes or a transcript with times into clean YouTube chapter timestamps.

text.description: Lines with times and titles, e.g. '0:00 Intro' or a transcript with timestamps

tools.name: clip_export_calculator
tools.description: Compute crop size, export resolution and clip count for turning a video into vertical clips.

tools.name: score_hook
tools.description: Score the opening line of a short video (0-100) for scroll-stopping power and get 3 stronger rewrites.

hook.description: The first sentence spoken or shown in the video

tools.name: get_youtube_thumbnails
tools.description: Return direct links to every thumbnail size of a YouTube video (i.ytimg.com image URLs). Docs: https://clips.bio/tools/youtube-thumbnail-downloader

tools.name: find_most_replayed_moments
tools.description: Find the moments viewers rewatch most in a YouTube video, from YouTube's own Most Replayed graph: start/end timestamps, relative replay score and the chapter each sits in. Docs: https://clips.bio/tools/most-replayed

tools.name: make_clips_link
tools.description: Get a clips.bio link that turns a long video (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Vimeo, Loom, Drive, Dropbox) into scored vertical clips with captions. The first preview is free, no signup. Docs: https://clips.bio/mcp-server

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current clips.bio plans, minutes per month and prices in USD.
